name: pi-sandbox
description: OS-level sandboxing for pi with interactive permission prompts
author: Chris Arderne <chris@rdrn.me>

scripts.fmt: oxfmt .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs index.ts protection.ts *.mts *.mjs tests/*.mjs src/**/*.ts extensions/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs index.ts protection.ts *.mjs tests/*.mjs src/**/*.ts extensions/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts
scripts.ci:fmt: node .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs oxfmt --check .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs index.ts protection.ts *.mts *.mjs tests/*.mjs src/**/*.ts extensions/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts
scripts.ci:lint: node .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs oxlint .forgejo/ci/run-oxc.mjs index.ts protection.ts *.mjs tests/*.mjs src/**/*.ts extensions/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run ci:fmt && pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:check && pnpm run ci:test
